reviews.title: WiFi randomly drops and slow customer service
reviews.text: WiFi randomly drops and slow customer service. Will work great for a few weeks and then randomly drop the Wi-Fi, and then it’s impossible to reconnect the Wi-Fi because it doesn’t recognize the Wi-Fi network. Customer service is slow and hardly reacts, as if there’s no customer service for this company.

reviews.title: A life changer for sleep!
reviews.text: I tried jet bed and eight sleep but they had limitations I couldn’t live with. Chilisleep is the one I can’t live without! Sounds dramatic but it’s true, I never get hot or sweaty while sleeping anymore. I get great sleep with it! Also, I’ve been using it for years and it’s been super reliable.

reviews.title: App Feature
reviews.text: The app should include already built profiles to choose from, like “David” who is a hot sleeper. Or “Jane” who is cold. Then a user can just select to be one of these dummy profiles. Otherwise, the system and hardware work well and are well made. The instructions are easy to follow.

reviews.title: Great Investment
reviews.text: So many benefits.  Push to cloud login is only downside.

reviews.title: Sleeping Through the Night
reviews.text: The Chilipad is amazing. I sleep so well through the night. It’s the best investment you can make!

reviews.title: 2.0 Chilipad
reviews.text: I know this gadget is expensive but for me it’s been worth every penny. It’s only on my side of the king bed. I am in AZ and it’s so hot here in additional to my hot flashes. I love how cold it gets. You can adjust it and set a schedule.

reviews.title: Life-Changing ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.text: I’ve been using various versions of the Chilipad for nearly a decade. It’s absolutely revolutionized my sleep, and life as a result. The newest 2026 goes above and beyond.  Most think of it as a summer tool, but it’s also a game-changer in cold winters. Not to mention saving a fortune on climate control. A must-have!

reviews.title: It’s great
reviews.text: Love to control my sleep temperature

reviews.title: New Design is Fantastic
reviews.text: This new design fantastic. The new fabric is super cool and much more efficient. This is my third one, but this is the best one this new design. I really sleep well.  Hope it lasts longer than the last two since this is made in the US and has an extra year warranty made me feel a little better, but I can’t do without this thing. It’s just fantastic.

reviews.title: Life-changing
reviews.text: Rarely do I write reviews. But I have been so appreciative for the Chilipad for the six months that I’ve had it. It makes sleeping during the warm summers so much better. My sleep is deeper. Even when I take a nap on a hot day, it cools me down significantly by the time I get up. Plus, I enjoy switching it to the warm mode in the mornings as I’m slowly waking up and warming my body. It’s super quiet. Has worked great. I used to love traveling but now it means I have to be away from my Chilipad so I think twice. 😊

reviews.title: Life-changing!
reviews.text: Once you dial in the perfect temperature for you, it is amazing. I can sleep with 1000 blankets on me as I prefer, including a weighted blanket, but not be too hot. I can also have the bed heat up to really warm in the morning to help me get out of bed….:) we are building a second home and are definitely buying a Chilipad for this home as well.

reviews.title: Life changing!!!
reviews.text: I have perimenopause and the Chilipad has literally made my life so much better. I don’t toss and turn from hot flashes, I sleep soundly, and I’m so much happier because of it!!

reviews.title: Manages hot flashes
reviews.text: With the chilipad I sleep all night.  I do not spend all night managing my hot flashes with blankets on and off.  It is a lifesaver!

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: While I like the temperature control of this new version, there are some drawbacks. The previous version was quieter.  I expected much quieter with the new pad than it actually is. Additionally, it does not stay flat on the bed no matter what I do. I have tucked and pulled to no avail.  The surface feels a bit plastic like or slick compared to the old fabric feel of version 1.   Overall the pad still keeps me cool and I’m grateful for that but I truly found the earlier version a better product

reviews.title: Fixes night sweats
reviews.text: The Chilipad has been my hack for surviving night sweats. I no longer wake up every night at 4am and my sleep monitor says I’m sleeping more deeply. Thank you Chilipad!

reviews.title: Love

reviews.title: Chilipad
reviews.text: I have owned the pad for little over a year. Overall I love it and can’t imagine sleeping without it. Two negatives are 1) the size. It’s larger so may not fit under your bed. 2) within first year the connector didn’t fit well and had to replace the mattress. Other than that it’s perfect t.

reviews.title: Really needs updates
reviews.text:
I’m writing this after trying my Chillipad 2.0 for the first night and being absolutely COOKED ALIVE by the “Warm Awake” feature. It sounded like a great idea last night because I usually wake up cold, but it’s more like a “hot awake” than a “warm awake”! You’d think you could customize the warm awake temperature, but it literally gives you no other option than “HIGH” or “OFF” which is a real shame because “HIGH” is uncomfortably HOT! 

Update: The closest workaround I can find is to “add adjustment” to the REM schedule for 5 minutes before the wake up time, but then you have to turn the actual warm awake feature off. 

Also the Chillipad 2.0 was advertised as having in-bed detection. The online guides say that the remote unit should have a setting for “radar”, but on the Remote’s firmware version 1.11.310, it’s not visible. I also don’t see any mention of the feature in the app. What’s up with that? I was also generally hoping that the Chillipad could log the time I hit the bed with Apple Health even if it doesn’t capture all the biometrics. Just knowing what time I hit the bed and logging that over time in Apple Health would be a huge step forward in tracking my sleep goals. The iPhone estimates the time you started sleeping by the time you put down your phone, but I wanna know what time I hit the bed.

reviews.title: The best sleep system
reviews.text: Super happy with the sleep I get with my Chilipad. Easy to use , intuitive app, and very comfortable. 6 out of 5 stars.

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text:
Add Partner links (via Branch) do not work. Currently impossible to add my partner to the bed on my app.

Low water notifications are flakey. I frequently see the low water icon show up and then disappear quickly. Once, I was actually out of water, I added some and the app refused to acknowledge. I could not operate the bed via the app at all for 39 minutes, though I could from the remote.

reviews.title: Chilipad
reviews.text: The best present that my husband ever gave me because I am going through menopause. It gave me peace of mind at bedtime!

reviews.title: Looks good, but
reviews.text: The new update looks good, but the cards are backwards when you have two dock pros connected

reviews.title: Great app, but missing a key feature
reviews.text: Since my husband and I got our Chilipads some months ago, we're no longer affected by the temp in our bedroom. In short, it's been amazing. The app is slick and the recent overhaul was a welcome change. However, it is desperately in need of a vacation mode! We just had a week away from home for a vacation, and had to unplug our pads so we wouldn't forget to shut off the automatic routine. Other than that, it's been a great app.

reviews.title: Great but not perfect
reviews.text: I love my chillipad. Has ruined sleeping anywhere else. I would give it 5 stars but….it constantly runs out of water. I had to purchase a water distilling machine because I got tired of spending more money on bottles of distilled water. The reservoir is too small and gets mildew easily which makes me concerned for sinus congestion and allergies and general safety. Would be nice if they incorporated an ozone system for sterilization. I would buy and sell it to others all day!

reviews.title: The Chilipad is great but this app update sucks
reviews.text: Recently you changed the app so I only see one temperature. It used to show current temp and the temp setting. Now it’s confusing and I don’t like it. Every thermostat shows current temp and goal/set temp.

reviews.title: Good bye hot flashes!!
reviews.text: I’d give up my dishwasher just to be able to keep my Chilipad. This has been a game changer for this menopausal woman. I sleep like I am a teenager again. Run, don’t walk to get your own.

reviews.title: Favorite thing
reviews.text: I’d buy this 1000x over. Has it for 1 years and it’s a must have that I can’t live without now.

reviews.title: Menopause relief
reviews.text: I cannot sleep without it!

reviews.title: 10 stars if possible
reviews.text: My entire life I’ve slept terrible. Over heating, waking up congested, not rested. Until this ice pack of a invention came. The Chilipad completely changed my sleep and recovery, I’m sleeping through the night, feeling rested and cooling down instead of overheating.

reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.text: I’m on my second unit. I had the original chili pad cube. And finding the perfect  sleep temp has changed my sleep game

reviews.title: Tangible Results
reviews.text:
I’ve been extremely happy with my Chilipad. Since I started using it, I’ve seen measurable improvements in my sleep quality as tracked by my Garmin, including better sleep scores and improved overnight recovery. It’s been great to see objective data match how I actually feel in the morning.

My favorite features are the warm wake-up, which makes getting out of bed much easier, and the cooling during hot summer nights. Staying at a comfortable temperature throughout the night has made a noticeable difference in my sleep. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to improve their sleep quality.

reviews.title: Love the technology, but…
reviews.text: It definitely helps me sleep better. But I’m on my fifth Dock Pro.  Manufacturing quality control is definitely a problem.

reviews.title: Terrible update
reviews.text: Been a chilipad customer for a decade. This app update broke everything. They came out with a new device and revamped the app in the process and broke the existing units. It has been this way for months now. Trying to change the temperature on the unit via the app does nothing and I have to manually adjust it. It also can’t even get basics right like remembering I use Fahrenheit.

reviews.title: Bad update to great product
reviews.text: Why in the world devs would “improve “ a user interface with a more clunky version boggles the mind. You took a stylish easy to use dial with a large display and made a smaller version that you have to hit multiple times to change the temperature. Awful update. Truly. Made your product more tedious to use.

reviews.title: One of my favorite purchases
reviews.text:
Chilipad has been a game changer for me. I’ve been a hot sleeper I think most of my life. Moving to a drier heat state in my 20’s, I dreaded summer. Air conditioning just wasn’t enough at times and I started to really worry about how I would function when menopause hit. I started going to bed with wet washcloths, ziploc bags of ice, etc. My initial searches for products… I found things that would cool for several hours, but I’d need to swap out middle of the night. Ugh! Then I stumbled on Chilipad. Best thing ever!!! I use it every night all year long. I just adjust the temp in the winter. I finally experienced a night of sleeping without waking up sweaty. I no longer wake up in the middle of the night during the summer because I’m so hot. I can snuggle under covers and feel cozy yet still be nice and cool with the Chilipad on. Take a nap during the day? Chilipad. Sitting up in bed working on computer, paying bills? Pop on Chilipad. 

It’s so amazing! 
Pleasssee don’t ever stop making Chilipad.

reviews.title: Please fix
reviews.text: Latest app release is terrible.  Please return the ability to turn off the power using Wi-Fi connection.  Bluetooth won’t connect. Now unit is not shutting off based schedule.

reviews.title: Quit Changing the name
reviews.text: Jesus Christ what is the marketing team at this company doing? Ooler, SleepMe, and now chillipad. I have to think about what the name of the godforsaken product is every single time.

reviews.title: Was amazing till the update
reviews.text: The old app with the slider made controlling the chilipad so easy. Now with this update I can’t adjust my side of the bed unless I use the sleep program and can’t control my partners side while she is away.

reviews.title: Update 26.04
reviews.text: This update effectively inactivated the sleep scoring and sleep metrics review, at least on my dock, plus tracker set up.  The dock is still receiving information from the tracker, because the dock is adjusting the temperature based on sleep activity.  The sleep score and metrics aren’t visible however, so the feedback process is broken.  I can’t see the REM times or when I woke up or was more restless.   I have rebooted everything twice, gone through the reported help algorithms and FAQs.  I searched a couple of boards. Three weeks troubleshooting every available intervention, no progress. The help desk process is cumbersome and slow. I sent an email, they ask back a question, I answer the question, they send another question. This has been times four emails. No actual progress. Vague talk of escalation.  Imagine a bank of AI bot and two overwhelmed people, waiting for a chance to send a summary to the actual coders and tech experts.  It begs the question about who designed the update, maybe three people who did some vibe coating, it seemed good, so they released it. This is a good product and they’ve burned through a lot of customer good will for uncertain ends.

reviews.title: Chilipad to the rescue!
reviews.text: I have owned a Chilipad for over 4 years now and love this product. It saved my sleep and my sanity. I purchased the dock pro for myself for my 50th birthday and love love love it! It is the best gift I ever bought for myself. We lost AC yesterday and I set the temp of my Chilipad down to 67 degrees and slept just fine. This is literally saving me until my AC gets repaired. I can’t say enough about this product and I highly recommend it to others.

reviews.title: Currently Broken
reviews.text:
When I use the main bed control for temperature or power, only one side responds. The other side does nothing unless I manually open that individual side and control it separately.

I have two Dock Pros set up as one dual-zone bed. Both Dock Pros are online and both can be controlled individually in the app. I deleted the bed, fully disconnected both units, reconnected them, and rebuilt the dual-zone bed from scratch.

Pretty frustrating when a product this expensive fails on such a basic level.

reviews.title: Schedules not working
reviews.text: Since updating to the new version the schedules no longer start. I’ve tried deleting and recreating them, but it hasn’t made a difference.

reviews.title: Good App, but…
reviews.text:
My main complaint is that I can’t set a time for it to automatically turn off without also having a set schedule for it to turn on and a whole night temperature schedule.

I just want to be able to have it set to turn off automatically at say 8 am.

Also, the new app deleted out the rest of my family’s ability to control their chili pads via the app, which I still haven’t figured out how to restore. They still work fine via the buttons on the machines, but I don’t seem to be able to send invites to them to control their chili pads any more.

Please help!

reviews.title: Update has taken a step back
reviews.text: Ever since the update, nothing seems to be working correctly. Programs either don’t run as they are set or sleep is not tracked as accurate as it was prior to the update.

reviews.title: Horrible update!! Give us an option to revert!!
reviews.text:
The new version is hard to navigate and has a terrible UI. While it allows people with more than one system to manage multiple beds and group devices together, managing your own device is horrid. The text is small and the temp control is more tedious to control. I need minimum interaction with an app if I need to adjust the temp in the middle of the night, especially if the “Hiber AI” function does not work properly and accidentally turns the heat up to 120 when it thinks that I’m awake to lull me back to sleep (which inadvertently wakes me up).

Either give us a way to revert to the old app or give us a physical remote. This is terrible
